d: We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Brand Manager to lead and enhance the market presence of our automotive brands. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing brand strategies, driving marketing initiatives, overseeing product launch activities, and ensuring consistent brand positioning across all customer touchpoints. The role requires close collaboration with sales, aftersales, digital marketing, agencies, and principal partners to maximize brand awareness, customer engagement, and commercial performance.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
Minimum 5-8 years of experience in brand management, marketing, or product marketing.
Previous experience within the automotive industry is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience managing marketing campaigns, product launches, and brand development initiatives.
Strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, CRM, and customer journey management.
Experience working with automotive manufacturers, dealer networks, or regional distributors is an advantage.
Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.
r: li
Develop and implement comprehensive brand strategies aligned with business objectives and market opportunities.
li
Plan, execute, and evaluate integrated marketing campaigns across traditional and digital channels.
li
Manage annual brand marketing budgets and ensure optimal return on investment (ROI).
li
Coordinate new vehicle launches, model refreshes, promotional campaigns, and customer events.
li
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and consumer insights to identify growth opportunities.
li

li

li

li
Analyze campaign performance, customer engagement metrics, and sales data to measure effectiveness and recommend improvements.
li

li
Collaborate with Aftersales, CRM, and Customer Experience teams to strengthen customer retention and loyalty initiatives.
li
Prepare regular reports and presentations for senior management on brand performance and marketing effectiveness.

d: We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Sales Executive with at least 4 years of experience in the poultry industry. The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, managing existing customer relationships, achieving sales targets, and expanding the company's market presence in the poultry sector.
q: Develop and maintain strong relationships with poultry farms, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and other business customers.
Promote and sell poultry products, including fresh and frozen chicken and related products.
Identify new customers and business opportunities to expand market coverage.
Achieve monthly and annual sales targets as assigned by management.
Conduct regular customer visits, market research, and competitor analysis.
Prepare sales quotations, negotiate pricing, and close business deals.
Coordinate with production, logistics, and distribution teams to ensure timely product delivery.
Monitor customer payments and coordinate with the finance team for outstanding collections.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
Handle customer complaints and ensure customer satisfaction.
Strong knowledge of the poultry industry and its market dynamics.
Experience in selling poultry products and developing distribution channels.
Good negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to achieve sales targets and develop new business.
Knowledge of market pricing, competitors, and customer requirements.
Good reporting and MS Office skills.
Valid Saudi driving licence is preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Agriculture, or a related field.
Minimum 4+ years of experience in sales within the poultry industry.
Experience dealing with poultry farms, distributors, wholesalers, and retail customers.
Candidates with experience in the Saudi poultry market will be preferred.
